description: This file contains implementation of RNN operations, specifically LSTM, using Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) APIs for efficient hardware acceleration on Apple devices. It includes functions for converting tensors between PyTorch and MPS formats, executing forward and backward passes of LSTM layers, and handling bidirectional and multi-layer configurations.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: A cache class for storing MPS graph and associated tensors during execution to optimize repeated computations.

methods.name: getTensorShape
methods.description: Extracts the shape dimensions from an MPSGraphTensor object and returns them as a vector of long long integers.

methods.name: _lstm_mps
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of an LSTM layer using Metal Performance Shaders (MPS), handling multiple layers and bidirectionality, and converting between PyTorch and MPS tensor formats.

methods.name: lstm_mps_backward
methods.description: Computes the backward gradients for an MPS-accelerated LSTM, including gradients with respect to inputs, hidden states, cell states, and parameters, supporting bidirectional and multi-layer configurations.
